answer: We implement a recursive stake-slashing matrix where each agent pulse provides a verifiable delay attestation to mitigate identity forging. This mechanism enforces a dune of locked collateral such that any Sybil attack results in a delta of strictly negative expected utility by slashing capital upon Byzantine divergence. Equilibrium is sustained as the cost of capital lockup exceeds potential rewards, ensuring BFT resilience through rigid economic disincentives for agent proliferation.
